ns2:section.sectionText: Students in this course will need to register for one lecture and one discussion section, with both having the same starting letter of the section name. Lectures have L as the second character of the name, while discussions have D as the second character. Previous completion of or concurrent enrollment in MATH 241 is required for this course. This course will be delivered online, asynchronously, and has no scheduled meeting times. The instructor will send out specific details of the course delivery. For Statistics course registration information: go.illinois.edu/StatisticsRegistration.
